decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb for pressing or afflicting. The way of the disciple includes hardship and persecution (5:10-12).

decisions.choice: life: the life of the age to come
decisions.reason: Life here is entering the kingdom (19:16-17, 29; 25:46).

decisions.choice: apretado
decisions.reason: The Greek word means pressed in, hemmed in by trouble (meaning decision m1), not only narrow. "Apretado" keeps the picture of pressure; Balanced and Readable say "difícil", as the English says "hard".

decisions.choice: yenye dhiki (pressed, troubled)
decisions.reason: The Greek word means pressed in, hemmed in by trouble (meaning decision m1), not only narrow. Literal keeps that picture with "dhiki"; Balanced and Readable say "ngumu" (hard), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "押し狭められて" (L); "苦しく険しい" (B); "険しい" (R)
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb for pressing and afflicting (m1), so it is more than narrow: Literal keeps the picture of pressing, and Balanced and Readable say that it is a hard road.

source.text: Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν ψευδοπροφητῶν, οἵτινες ἔρχονται πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ἐνδύμασι προβάτων ἔσωθεν δέ εἰσιν λύκοι ἅρπαγες.

records.literal_gloss: Beware of the false prophets, who come to you in clothing of sheep inwardly but are wolves ravenous.

en.L: Beware of the false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
en.B: Watch out for false prophets. They come to you looking like sheep, but underneath they are hungry wolves.
en.R: Watch out for people who say they speak for God but do not. They come to you looking gentle like sheep, but inside they are like hungry wolves.

es.L: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado con los falsos profetas, los cuales se {{plural_you:les|os}} acercan con ropa de ovejas, pero por dentro son lobos voraces.
es.B: {{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}} de los falsos profetas. Vienen a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con apariencia de ovejas, pero por debajo son lobos hambrientos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}} de los que dicen que hablan de parte de Dios, pero no es así. Vienen a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con aspecto manso, como ovejas, pero por dentro son como lobos hambrientos.

fr.L: Gardez-vous des faux prophètes, qui viennent à vous en vêtements de brebis, mais au-dedans ce sont des loups voraces.
fr.B: Méfiez-vous des faux prophètes. Ils viennent à vous avec l’apparence de brebis, mais au fond ce sont des loups affamés.
fr.R: Faites attention aux gens qui disent qu’ils parlent de la part de Dieu, mais qui ne le font pas. Ils viennent vers vous doux comme des moutons, mais à l’intérieur ils sont comme des loups affamés.

sw.L: Jilindeni dhidi ya manabii wa uongo, ambao wanakuja kwenu katika mavazi ya kondoo, lakini kwa ndani ni mbwa mwitu wanyang'anyi.
sw.B: Kaeni macho na manabii wa uongo. Wanakuja kwenu wakionekana kama kondoo, lakini ndani yao ni mbwa mwitu wenye njaa.
sw.R: Kaeni macho na watu wanaodai kwamba wanasema kwa niaba ya Mungu, lakini sivyo. Wanakuja kwenu wakionekana wapole kama kondoo, lakini ndani yao ni kama mbwa mwitu wenye njaa.

vi.L: Hãy coi chừng các tiên tri giả, là những kẻ đến với các con trong lớp áo chiên, nhưng bên trong là lang sói hung dữ.
vi.B: Hãy đề phòng các tiên tri giả. Họ đến với các con trông như chiên, nhưng bên trong là những con sói đói mồi.
vi.R: Hãy đề phòng những người tự xưng là nói thay Đức Chúa Trời nhưng không phải vậy. Họ đến với các con trông hiền lành như chiên, nhưng bên trong họ giống như những con sói đói.

ko.L: 거짓 예언자들을 조심하여라. 그들은 양의 옷을 입고 너희에게 오지만, 속은 사나운 이리들이다.
ko.B: 거짓 예언자들을 경계하여라. 그들은 양처럼 보이는 모습으로 너희에게 오지만, 속은 굶주린 이리들이다.
ko.R: 하나님의 말씀을 전한다고 하지만 사실은 그렇지 않은 사람들을 조심하여라. 그들은 양처럼 순한 모습으로 너희에게 온다. 그러나 속은 굶주린 늑대와 같다.

pt.L: Cuidado com os falsos profetas, que vêm até vocês em roupas de ovelhas, mas por dentro são lobos vorazes.
pt.B: Tenham cuidado com os falsos profetas. Eles chegam a vocês parecendo ovelhas, mas por dentro são lobos famintos.
pt.R: Tenham cuidado com as pessoas que dizem falar em nome de Deus, mas não falam. Elas chegam a vocês parecendo mansas como ovelhas, mas por dentro são como lobos famintos.

am.L: ከሐሰተኛ ነቢያት ተጠንቀቁ፤ እነርሱ የበግ ልብስ ለብሰው ወደ እናንተ ይመጣሉ፤ ውስጣቸው ግን ነጣቂ ተኩላዎች ናቸው።
am.B: ከሐሰተኛ ነቢያት ተጠበቁ። በግ መስለው ይመጡባችኋል፤ ውስጣቸው ግን የተራቡ ተኩላዎች ናቸው።
am.R: በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንናገራለን እያሉ ከሚዋሹ ሰዎች ተጠበቁ። እንደ በግ የዋሆች መስለው ይመጡባችኋል፤ ውስጣቸው ግን እንደ ተራቡ ተኩላዎች ናቸው።

ru.L: Остерегайтесь лжепророков, которые приходят к вам в овечьей одежде, а внутри — хищные волки.
ru.B: Берегитесь лжепророков. Они приходят к вам с виду как овцы, а внутри — голодные волки.
ru.R: Остерегайтесь людей, которые говорят, что говорят от имени Бога, но это неправда. Они приходят к вам с виду кроткие, как овцы, а внутри они как голодные волки.

hi.L: झूठे भविष्यद्वक्ताओं से सावधान रहो, जो भेड़ों के वेश में तुम्हारे पास आते हैं, पर भीतर से फाड़नेवाले भेड़िये हैं।
hi.B: झूठे भविष्यद्वक्ताओं से बचकर रहो। वे भेड़ों जैसे दिखकर तुम्हारे पास आते हैं, पर अंदर से वे भूखे भेड़िये हैं।
hi.R: उन लोगों से बचकर रहो जो कहते हैं कि वे परमेश्वर की ओर से बोलते हैं, पर ऐसा नहीं है। वे भेड़ों की तरह सीधे-सादे बनकर तुम्हारे पास आते हैं, पर अंदर से वे भूखे भेड़ियों जैसे हैं।

uk.L: Стережіться лжепророків, які приходять до вас в овечому одязі, а всередині вони — хижі вовки.
uk.B: Остерігайтеся лжепророків. Вони приходять до вас на вигляд як вівці, а насправді вони — голодні вовки.
uk.R: Остерігайтеся людей, які кажуть, що говорять від Бога, але це неправда. Вони приходять до вас лагідні на вигляд, як вівці, але всередині вони наче голодні вовки.

ja.L: 偽預言者たちから身を守りなさい。彼らは羊の衣服を着てあなたがたのもとに来るが、その中身は奪い取る狼である。
ja.B: 偽預言者に気をつけなさい。彼らは羊のような姿であなたがたのところに来るが、中身は飢えた狼である。
ja.R: 神の言葉を語っているふりをして、本当はそうでない人たちに、気をつけなさい。その人たちは、羊のようにおとなしい姿で、あなたたちのところに来る。でも、中身は、おなかをすかせたオオカミのようだ。

decisions.choice: false prophets: those who claim to speak for God but lead people astray
decisions.reason: Israel had long been warned against them (Deuteronomy 13:1-5; Jeremiah 23:16). Jesus warns of them again in 24:11, 24.

decisions.choice: sheep's clothing, wolves: harmless outside, dangerous within
decisions.reason: The flock is God's people; the wolves look like members of it but prey on it.

decisions.choice: people who say they speak for God but do not
decisions.reason: Readable says what a false prophet is.

decisions.choice: "tiên tri giả" (L, B); "những người tự xưng là nói thay Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the term as the English Readable does; "chiên" is the Bible word for sheep, as in John 10.

decisions.choice: "거짓 예언자" (L, B), explained (R); "이리" (L, B), "늑대" (R)
decisions.reason: "예언자" as in 7:12; Readable says who they are, as the English Readable does. "이리" is the word of the familiar sayings about sheep and wolves; Readable uses the everyday "늑대".

decisions.choice: three clauses in the Greek order: the warning, then "they come ...", then "inwardly they are ..."
alternatives: one sentence with the relative clauses before "ሐሰተኛ ነቢያት"
decisions.reason: Amharic relative clauses stand before their noun and would put the warning last; Literal makes the Greek relative clause a clause of its own so the sequence stays.

decisions.choice: "झूठे भविष्यद्वक्ता" (L, B); described in Readable
decisions.reason: The book's word for prophet at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what a false prophet is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: 'лжепророки' (L, B); 'люди, которые говорят, что говорят от имени Бога' (R)
decisions.reason: 'Пророк' is this translation's word for a prophet; Literal and Balanced keep the compound 'лжепророк', and Readable says what a false prophet is.

decisions.choice: "偽預言者" (L, B); "神の言葉を語っているふりをして、本当はそうでない人たち" (R); "狼" (L, B), "オオカミ" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what a false prophet is (m1), as the English does. "狼" is not a Jōyō kanji, so Readable writes it in katakana.

source.text: ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιγνώσεσθε αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: By the fruits of them you will know them.

en.L: By their fruits you will recognize them.
en.B: You will know them by what their lives produce.
en.R: You will know who they are by what they do.

es.L: Por sus frutos los {{plural_you:reconocerán|reconoceréis}}.
es.B: Los {{plural_you:conocerán|conoceréis}} por lo que sus vidas producen.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} quiénes son por lo que hacen.

fr.L: À leurs fruits vous les reconnaîtrez.
fr.B: Vous les reconnaîtrez à ce que produit leur vie.
fr.R: Vous saurez qui ils sont en regardant ce qu’ils font.

sw.L: Kwa matunda yao mtawatambua.
sw.B: Mtawajua kwa yale ambayo maisha yao huzaa.
sw.R: Mtajua wao ni watu wa aina gani kwa yale wanayoyatenda.

vi.L: Nhờ trái của họ, các con sẽ nhận ra họ.
vi.B: Các con sẽ nhận biết họ qua những gì đời sống họ sinh ra.
vi.R: Các con sẽ biết họ là ai qua những việc họ làm.

ko.L: 그들의 열매들로 너희가 그들을 알아볼 것이다.
ko.B: 너희는 그들의 삶이 맺는 열매를 보고 그들을 알아볼 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 하는 일을 보면 그들이 어떤 사람인지 알 수 있다.

pt.L: Pelos frutos deles vocês os reconhecerão.
pt.B: Vocês os conhecerão pelo que a vida deles produz.
pt.R: Vocês vão saber quem eles são pelo que eles fazem.

am.L: በፍሬያቸው ታውቋቸዋላችሁ።
am.B: ሕይወታቸው በሚያፈራው ነገር ታውቋቸዋላችሁ።
am.R: በሚያደርጉት ነገር ማንነታቸውን ታውቃላችሁ።

ru.L: По их плодам узнаете их.
ru.B: Вы узнаете их по тому, что приносит их жизнь.
ru.R: Вы узнаете, кто они, по их делам.

hi.L: उनके फलों के द्वारा तुम उन्हें पहचानोगे।
hi.B: उनके जीवन के फल से तुम उन्हें जान लोगे।
hi.R: वे जो करते हैं, उससे तुम जान जाओगे कि वे कौन हैं।

uk.L: З їхніх плодів пізнаєте їх.
uk.B: Ви впізнаєте їх з того, що приносить їхнє життя.
uk.R: Ви дізнаєтеся, хто вони, з того, що вони роблять.

ja.L: 彼らの実によって、あなたがたは彼らを見分ける。
ja.B: 彼らの生き方が結ぶ実によって、あなたがたは彼らを見分ける。
ja.R: その人たちがすることを見れば、どんな人かがわかる。

decisions.choice: fruits: what a person's life produces, in deeds and in teaching
decisions.reason: As in 3:8 and 12:33, fruit is the outcome of a life. False prophets show what they are by how they live and by what their teaching produces.

decisions.choice: "trái" (L); "những gì đời sống họ sinh ra" (B); "những việc họ làm" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision explains the fruit as what a life produces in deeds and teaching. Literal keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does. Also in 7:20.

decisions.choice: "実" (L); "生き方が結ぶ実" (B); "すること" (R); the same in 7:20
decisions.reason: Fruit is what a life produces, in deeds and teaching (m1). Balanced keeps the picture, which 7:16b-19 go on to use, and says whose fruit it is; Readable says it plainly.

source.text: μήτι συλλέγουσιν ἀπὸ ἀκανθῶν σταφυλὰς ἢ ἀπὸ τριβόλων σῦκα;

records.literal_gloss: Not do they gather from thorns grapes or from thistles figs?

en.L: Do they gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
en.B: Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
en.R: People do not pick grapes from thornbushes or figs from weeds.

es.L: ¿Acaso recogen de los espinos uvas, o de los cardos higos?
es.B: ¿Se cosechan uvas de las zarzas, o higos de los cardos?
es.R: La gente no saca uvas de las zarzas ni higos de la mala hierba.

fr.L: Cueille-t-on des raisins sur des épines, ou des figues sur des chardons ?
fr.B: Ramasse-t-on du raisin sur des buissons d’épines, ou des figues sur des chardons ?
fr.R: On ne cueille pas de raisin sur des buissons d’épines, ni de figues sur des mauvaises herbes.

sw.L: Je, watu huvuna zabibu kutoka kwenye miiba, au tini kutoka kwenye mibaruti?
sw.B: Je, watu huchuma zabibu kwenye vichaka vya miiba, au tini kwenye mibaruti?
sw.R: Watu hawachumi zabibu kwenye miiba, wala tini kwenye magugu.

vi.L: Người ta có hái nho từ bụi gai, hay hái vả từ cây tật lê không?
vi.B: Có ai hái được nho từ bụi gai, hay hái được trái vả từ cây tật lê không?
vi.R: Người ta không hái nho từ bụi gai hay hái trái vả từ cỏ dại.

ko.L: 가시나무에서 포도를, 엉겅퀴에서 무화과를 따겠느냐?
ko.B: 가시덤불에서 포도를 따거나 엉겅퀴에서 무화과를 따는 사람이 있느냐?
ko.R: 가시덤불에서 포도를 딸 수 없고, 잡초에서 무화과를 딸 수 없다.

pt.L: Por acaso colhem uvas de espinheiros, ou figos de cardos?
pt.B: Será que alguém colhe uvas de espinheiros ou figos de cardos?
pt.R: Ninguém colhe uvas de espinheiros nem figos de ervas daninhas.

am.L: ከእሾህ ወይን፣ ወይስ ከኩርንችት በለስ ይለቅማሉን?
am.B: ሰዎች ከእሾህ ቁጥቋጦ ወይን፣ ወይም ከኩርንችት በለስ ይለቅማሉን?
am.R: ሰዎች ከእሾህ ቁጥቋጦ ወይን ወይም ከአረም በለስ አይለቅሙም።

ru.L: Разве собирают с колючек виноград или с чертополоха смоквы?
ru.B: Разве собирают виноград с терновника или инжир с чертополоха?
ru.R: Люди не собирают виноград с колючих кустов или инжир с сорняков.

hi.L: क्या लोग काँटों से अंगूर, या ऊँटकटारों से अंजीर बटोरते हैं?
hi.B: क्या लोग कँटीली झाड़ियों से अंगूर, या ऊँटकटारों से अंजीर तोड़ते हैं?
hi.R: लोग कँटीली झाड़ियों से अंगूर या जंगली घास से अंजीर नहीं तोड़ते।

uk.L: Хіба збирають виноград з тернини або смокви з будяків?
uk.B: Хіба збирають виноград з тернових кущів, а інжир — з будяків?
uk.R: Люди не збирають винограду з тернових кущів чи інжиру з бурʼянів.

ja.L: いばらからぶどうを、あるいはあざみからいちじくを集めるだろうか？
ja.B: 人は、いばらからぶどうを摘んだり、あざみからいちじくを摘んだりするだろうか？
ja.R: いばらからぶどうは取れないし、雑草からいちじくも取れない。

decisions.choice: a question expecting the answer no
decisions.reason: The Greek form expects "no". Readable states the answer.

decisions.choice: 'смоквы' (L); 'инжир' (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark: Literal keeps the Bible word for the fruit, 'смоквы'; Balanced and Readable use 'инжир', what the fruit is called today.

decisions.choice: "смокви" (L); "інжир" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional "смокви"; Balanced and Readable say "інжир", the fruit's everyday name.

source.text: οὕτως πᾶν δένδρον ἀγαθὸν καρποὺς καλοὺς ποιεῖ, τὸ δὲ σαπρὸν δένδρον καρποὺς πονηροὺς ποιεῖ·

records.literal_gloss: So every tree good fruits good produces, the but bad tree fruits bad produces;

en.L: So every good tree produces good fruit, but the bad tree produces bad fruit.
en.B: In the same way, every healthy tree bears good fruit, and a diseased tree bears bad fruit.
en.R: In the same way, every good tree grows good fruit, and every bad tree grows bad fruit.

es.L: Así, todo árbol bueno produce frutos buenos, mas el árbol podrido produce frutos malos.
es.B: Del mismo modo, todo árbol sano da buen fruto, y el árbol enfermo da fruto malo.
es.R: De la misma manera, todo árbol bueno da fruta buena, y todo árbol malo da fruta mala.

fr.L: Ainsi, tout bon arbre produit de bons fruits, mais l’arbre mauvais produit de mauvais fruits.
fr.B: De même, tout arbre sain donne de bons fruits, et un arbre malade donne de mauvais fruits.
fr.R: De la même façon, chaque bon arbre fait pousser de bons fruits, et chaque mauvais arbre fait pousser de mauvais fruits.

sw.L: Hivyo kila mti mzuri huzaa matunda mazuri, lakini mti ulioharibika huzaa matunda mabaya.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, kila mti wenye afya huzaa matunda mazuri, na mti wenye ugonjwa huzaa matunda mabaya.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, kila mti mzuri huzaa matunda mazuri, na kila mti mbaya huzaa matunda mabaya.

vi.L: Vậy mọi cây tốt đều sinh trái tốt, còn cây xấu thì sinh trái xấu;
vi.B: Cũng vậy, cây lành thì sinh trái tốt, còn cây bệnh thì sinh trái xấu.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, cây tốt thì sinh ra trái tốt, cây xấu thì sinh ra trái xấu.

ko.L: 이와 같이 좋은 나무는 모두 좋은 열매들을 맺고, 나쁜 나무는 나쁜 열매들을 맺는다.
ko.B: 이처럼 건강한 나무는 모두 좋은 열매를 맺고, 병든 나무는 나쁜 열매를 맺는다.
ko.R: 이와 마찬가지로, 좋은 나무는 모두 좋은 열매를 맺고, 나쁜 나무는 나쁜 열매를 맺는다.

pt.L: Assim, toda árvore boa produz frutos bons, mas a árvore ruim produz frutos ruins.
pt.B: Do mesmo modo, toda árvore saudável dá bons frutos, e a árvore doente dá frutos ruins.
pt.R: Do mesmo jeito, toda árvore boa dá frutas boas, e toda árvore ruim dá frutas ruins.

am.L: እንዲሁም በጎ ዛፍ ሁሉ በጎ ፍሬ ያፈራል፤ መጥፎው ዛፍ ግን መጥፎ ፍሬ ያፈራል።
am.B: በዚሁ ዓይነት ጤናማ ዛፍ ሁሉ መልካም ፍሬ ያፈራል፤ የታመመ ዛፍ ግን መጥፎ ፍሬ ያፈራል።
am.R: በዚሁ ዓይነት ጥሩ ዛፍ ሁሉ ጥሩ ፍሬ ያፈራል፤ መጥፎ ዛፍ ሁሉ ደግሞ መጥፎ ፍሬ ያፈራል።

ru.L: Так всякое хорошее дерево приносит хорошие плоды, а гнилое дерево приносит плохие плоды.
ru.B: Так и всякое здоровое дерево приносит хорошие плоды, а больное дерево — плохие.
ru.R: Так и каждое хорошее дерево даёт хорошие плоды, а каждое плохое дерево — плохие.

hi.L: इसी तरह हर अच्छा पेड़ अच्छे फल लाता है, पर बुरा पेड़ बुरे फल लाता है।
hi.B: इसी तरह हर स्वस्थ पेड़ अच्छे फल देता है, और रोगी पेड़ बुरे फल देता है।
hi.R: इसी तरह हर अच्छे पेड़ पर अच्छे फल लगते हैं, और हर बुरे पेड़ पर बुरे फल।

uk.L: Так кожне добре дерево приносить добрі плоди, а погане дерево приносить погані плоди.
uk.B: Так само кожне здорове дерево родить добрі плоди, а хворе дерево родить погані плоди.
uk.R: Так само кожне добре дерево родить добрі плоди, а кожне погане дерево — погані.

ja.L: このように、良い木はどれも良い実を生み出し、腐った木は悪い実を生み出す。
ja.B: 同じように、健やかな木はみな良い実をつけ、病んだ木は悪い実をつける。
ja.R: 同じように、よい木にはよい実がなり、悪い木には悪い実がなる。

decisions.choice: bad: rotten, diseased, worthless
decisions.reason: The word is used of rotten things. The tree's nature shows in its fruit.

decisions.choice: healthy, diseased
decisions.reason: Balanced uses words for trees.

decisions.choice: podrido
decisions.reason: The Greek word for the bad tree means rotten, diseased (meaning decision m1). Literal says "podrido" so the reader sees it is a different word from the "malos" of the fruit; Balanced says "enfermo", as the English says "diseased". The same in verse 18.

decisions.choice: "cây lành" and "cây bệnh" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision gives "rotten, diseased" for the word; Balanced speaks of the tree's health, as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: frutas (R); frutos (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Fruto" is the word for the outcome of a life (7:16) and the botanical word; "fruta" is what Brazilians pick and eat. Readable uses the everyday word in the picture of the tree, where the meaning is already plain.

decisions.choice: "腐った木" (L); "健やかな木" and "病んだ木" (B); "よい木" and "悪い木" (R); the same in 7:18
decisions.reason: The Greek word is used of rotten things (m1). Literal keeps it; Balanced uses words for the health of trees, as the English does.

source.text: οὐ δύναται δένδρον ἀγαθὸν καρποὺς πονηροὺς ποιεῖν, οὐδὲ δένδρον σαπρὸν καρποὺς καλοὺς ποιεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Not is able a tree good fruits bad to produce, nor a tree bad fruits good to produce.

en.L: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, nor can a bad tree produce good fruit.
en.B: A healthy tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a diseased tree cannot bear good fruit.
en.R: A good tree cannot grow bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot grow good fruit.

es.L: No puede un árbol bueno producir frutos malos, ni un árbol podrido producir frutos buenos.
es.B: Un árbol sano no puede dar fruto malo, y un árbol enfermo no puede dar fruto bueno.
es.R: Un árbol bueno no puede dar fruta mala, y un árbol malo no puede dar fruta buena.

fr.L: Un bon arbre ne peut pas produire de mauvais fruits, ni un arbre mauvais produire de bons fruits.
fr.B: Un arbre sain ne peut pas donner de mauvais fruits, et un arbre malade ne peut pas donner de bons fruits.
fr.R: Un bon arbre ne peut pas faire pousser de mauvais fruits, et un mauvais arbre ne peut pas faire pousser de bons fruits.

sw.L: Hauwezi mti mzuri kuzaa matunda mabaya, wala mti ulioharibika kuzaa matunda mazuri.
sw.B: Mti wenye afya hauwezi kuzaa matunda mabaya, na mti wenye ugonjwa hauwezi kuzaa matunda mazuri.
sw.R: Mti mzuri hauwezi kuzaa matunda mabaya, na mti mbaya hauwezi kuzaa matunda mazuri.

vi.L: Cây tốt không thể sinh trái xấu, cây xấu cũng không thể sinh trái tốt.
vi.B: Cây lành không thể sinh trái xấu, và cây bệnh cũng không thể sinh trái tốt.
vi.R: Cây tốt không thể sinh ra trái xấu, và cây xấu không thể sinh ra trái tốt.

ko.L: 좋은 나무가 나쁜 열매들을 맺을 수 없고, 나쁜 나무가 좋은 열매들을 맺을 수도 없다.
ko.B: 건강한 나무가 나쁜 열매를 맺을 수 없고, 병든 나무가 좋은 열매를 맺을 수도 없다.
ko.R: 좋은 나무는 나쁜 열매를 맺을 수 없고, 나쁜 나무는 좋은 열매를 맺을 수 없다.

pt.L: Não pode uma árvore boa produzir frutos ruins, nem uma árvore ruim produzir frutos bons.
pt.B: Uma árvore saudável não pode dar frutos ruins, e uma árvore doente não pode dar frutos bons.
pt.R: Uma árvore boa não pode dar frutas ruins, e uma árvore ruim não pode dar frutas boas.

am.L: በጎ ዛፍ መጥፎ ፍሬ ማፍራት አይችልም፤ መጥፎ ዛፍም በጎ ፍሬ ማፍራት አይችልም።
am.B: ጤናማ ዛፍ መጥፎ ፍሬ ማፍራት አይችልም፤ የታመመ ዛፍም መልካም ፍሬ ማፍራት አይችልም።
am.R: ጥሩ ዛፍ መጥፎ ፍሬ ሊያፈራ አይችልም፤ መጥፎ ዛፍም ጥሩ ፍሬ ሊያፈራ አይችልም።

ru.L: Не может хорошее дерево приносить плохие плоды, и гнилое дерево — приносить хорошие плоды.
ru.B: Здоровое дерево не может приносить плохих плодов, и больное дерево не может приносить хороших.
ru.R: Хорошее дерево не может давать плохие плоды, а плохое дерево не может давать хорошие.

hi.L: अच्छा पेड़ बुरे फल नहीं ला सकता, न बुरा पेड़ अच्छे फल ला सकता है।
hi.B: स्वस्थ पेड़ बुरे फल नहीं दे सकता, और रोगी पेड़ अच्छे फल नहीं दे सकता।
hi.R: अच्छे पेड़ पर बुरे फल नहीं लग सकते, और बुरे पेड़ पर अच्छे फल नहीं लग सकते।

uk.L: Не може добре дерево приносити поганих плодів, ані погане дерево — добрих плодів.
uk.B: Здорове дерево не може родити поганих плодів, а хворе дерево не може родити добрих.
uk.R: Добре дерево не може родити поганих плодів, а погане дерево не може родити добрих.

ja.L: 良い木は悪い実を生み出すことができず、腐った木も良い実を生み出すことはできない。
ja.B: 健やかな木が悪い実をつけることはできず、病んだ木が良い実をつけることもできない。
ja.R: よい木に悪い実がなることはないし、悪い木によい実がなることもない。

decisions.choice: cannot: what a person is will show in what they do
decisions.reason: The saying is about recognizing what is there. Jesus elsewhere calls for a tree to be made good (12:33).

source.text: πᾶν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

records.literal_gloss: Every tree not producing fruit good is cut down and into fire is thrown.

en.L: Every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and thrown into [the] fire.
en.B: Any tree that fails to bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
en.R: Every tree that does not grow good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

es.L: Todo árbol que no produce fruto bueno se corta y se arroja al fuego.
es.B: Todo árbol que no da buen fruto se corta y se echa al fuego.
es.R: Todo árbol que no da fruta buena será cortado y echado al fuego.

fr.L: Tout arbre qui ne produit pas de bon fruit est coupé et jeté au feu.
fr.B: Tout arbre qui ne donne pas de bon fruit est abattu et jeté au feu.
fr.R: Chaque arbre qui ne fait pas pousser de bons fruits sera coupé et jeté au feu.

sw.L: Kila mti usiozaa tunda zuri unakatwa na kutupwa katika moto.
sw.B: Mti wowote usiozaa matunda mazuri hukatwa, ukatupwa motoni.
sw.R: Kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri utakatwa na kutupwa motoni.

vi.L: Hễ cây nào không sinh trái tốt thì bị chặt và ném vào lửa.
vi.B: Cây nào không sinh trái tốt đều bị chặt xuống và ném vào lửa.
vi.R: Cây nào không sinh ra trái tốt sẽ bị chặt bỏ và ném vào lửa.

ko.L: 좋은 열매를 맺지 않는 나무는 모두 찍혀서 불에 던져진다.
ko.B: 좋은 열매를 맺지 못하는 나무는 모두 찍혀서 불 속에 던져진다.
ko.R: 좋은 열매를 맺지 않는 나무는 모두 베어져 불에 던져질 것이다.

pt.L: Toda árvore que não produz fruto bom é cortada e lançada [no] fogo.
pt.B: Toda árvore que não dá bons frutos é cortada e jogada no fogo.
pt.R: Toda árvore que não dá frutas boas vai ser cortada e jogada no fogo.

am.L: በጎ ፍሬ የማያፈራ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል፤ ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።
am.B: መልካም ፍሬ የማያፈራ ዛፍ ሁሉ ተቆርጦ ወደ እሳት ይጣላል።
am.R: ጥሩ ፍሬ የማያፈራ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል፤ ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

ru.L: Всякое дерево, не приносящее хорошего плода, срубается и бросается в огонь.
ru.B: Каждое дерево, которое не приносит хорошего плода, срубают и бросают в огонь.
ru.R: Каждое дерево, которое не даёт хороших плодов, срубят и бросят в огонь.

hi.L: हर पेड़ जो अच्छा फल नहीं लाता, काटा और आग में डाला जाता है।
hi.B: जो भी पेड़ अच्छा फल नहीं देता, उसे काटकर आग में डाल दिया जाता है।
hi.R: जिस पेड़ पर अच्छे फल नहीं लगते, उसे काटकर आग में डाल दिया जाएगा।

uk.L: Кожне дерево, що не приносить доброго плоду, зрубують і кидають у вогонь.
uk.B: Кожне дерево, яке не родить доброго плоду, зрубують і кидають у вогонь.
uk.R: Кожне дерево, на якому не росте добрий плід, зрубають і кинуть у вогонь.

ja.L: 良い実を生み出さない木はみな、切り倒されて火に投げ込まれる。
ja.B: 良い実をつけない木はみな、切り倒されて火に投げ込まれる。
ja.R: よい実がならない木は、どれも切り倒されて、火に投げ込まれる。

decisions.choice: the words of John the Baptist (3:10)
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats John's warning word for word. The levels repeat the wording they used at 3:10.

decisions.choice: the wording of John the Baptist's warning (3:10), to be kept identical there
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats John's words word for word (m1), and the levels repeat the wording they use at 3:10. 3:10 was drafted in parallel; if its Japanese differs, one of the two should be brought into line.

source.text: ἄρα γε ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιγνώσεσθε αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: So then by the fruits of them you will know them.

en.L: So then, by their fruits you will recognize them.
en.B: So you will know them by what their lives produce.
en.R: So you will know who they are by what they do.

es.L: Así pues, por sus frutos los {{plural_you:reconocerán|reconoceréis}}.
es.B: Así que los {{plural_you:conocerán|conoceréis}} por lo que sus vidas producen.
es.R: Así {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} quiénes son por lo que hacen.

fr.L: C’est donc à leurs fruits que vous les reconnaîtrez.
fr.B: Ainsi, vous les reconnaîtrez à ce que produit leur vie.
fr.R: Alors, vous saurez qui ils sont en regardant ce qu’ils font.

sw.L: Basi, kwa matunda yao mtawatambua.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo mtawajua kwa yale ambayo maisha yao huzaa.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mtajua wao ni watu wa aina gani kwa yale wanayoyatenda.

vi.L: Như vậy, nhờ trái của họ, các con sẽ nhận ra họ.
vi.B: Vậy, các con sẽ nhận biết họ qua những gì đời sống họ sinh ra.
vi.R: Vậy, các con sẽ biết họ là ai qua những việc họ làm.

ko.L: 그러므로 그들의 열매들로 너희가 그들을 알아볼 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 너희는 그들의 삶이 맺는 열매를 보고 그들을 알아볼 것이다.
ko.R: 그러니 그들이 하는 일을 보면 그들이 어떤 사람인지 알 수 있다.

pt.L: Assim, pois, pelos frutos deles vocês os reconhecerão.
pt.B: Então vocês os conhecerão pelo que a vida deles produz.
pt.R: Então vocês vão saber quem eles são pelo que eles fazem.

am.L: እንግዲያውስ በፍሬያቸው ታውቋቸዋላችሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ሕይወታቸው በሚያፈራው ነገር ታውቋቸዋላችሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ በሚያደርጉት ነገር ማንነታቸውን ታውቃላችሁ።

ru.L: Итак, по их плодам узнаете их.
ru.B: Итак, вы узнаете их по тому, что приносит их жизнь.
ru.R: Итак, вы узнаете, кто они, по их делам.

hi.L: सो उनके फलों के द्वारा तुम उन्हें पहचानोगे।
hi.B: इसलिए उनके जीवन के फल से तुम उन्हें जान लोगे।
hi.R: इसलिए वे जो करते हैं, उससे तुम जान जाओगे कि वे कौन हैं।

uk.L: Отже, з їхніх плодів пізнаєте їх.
uk.B: Тож ви впізнаєте їх з того, що приносить їхнє життя.
uk.R: Тож ви дізнаєтеся, хто вони, з того, що вони роблять.

ja.L: それで、まさに彼らの実によって、あなたがたは彼らを見分ける。
ja.B: だから、彼らの生き方が結ぶ実によって、あなたがたは彼らを見分ける。
ja.R: だから、その人たちがすることを見れば、どんな人かがわかる。

decisions.choice: fruits: what a person's life produces, in deeds and in teaching
decisions.reason: As in 3:8 and 12:33, fruit is the outcome of a life. False prophets show what they are by how they live and by what their teaching produces.

decisions.choice: the saying of 7:16 repeated, closing the section
decisions.reason: The repetition frames 7:16-20.

source.text: Οὐ πᾶς ὁ λέγων μοι· Κύριε κύριε εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἀλλ’ ὁ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: Not everyone the saying to me, Lord, Lord, will enter into the kingdom of the heavens, but the doing the will of the Father of me the in the heavens.

en.L: Not everyone who says to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, 'Lord, Lord,' will enter the kingdom of the heavens, but the one who does the will of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father who [is] in the heavens.
en.B: Not everyone who calls {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} 'Lord, Lord' will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only those who do what {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father in heaven wants.
en.R: Not everyone who calls {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} 'Lord' will enter the kingdom of heaven. Only those who do what {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father in heaven wants will enter.

es.L: No todo el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dice “Señor, Señor” entrará en el reino de los cielos, sino quien hace la voluntad de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre, el que [está] en los cielos.
es.B: No todo el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llama “Señor, Señor” entrará en el reino de los cielos, sino solo quienes hacen lo que quiere {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que está en el cielo.
es.R: No todo el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llama “Señor” entrará en el reino de los cielos. Solo entrarán los que hacen lo que quiere {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que está en el cielo.

fr.L: Ce n’est pas quiconque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dit : “Seigneur, Seigneur” qui entrera dans le royaume des cieux, mais celui qui fait la volonté de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui [est] dans les cieux.
fr.B: Ce ne sont pas tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appellent “Seigneur, Seigneur” qui entreront dans le royaume des cieux, mais seulement ceux qui font ce que veut {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui est au ciel.
fr.R: Tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appellent “Seigneur” n’entreront pas dans le royaume des cieux. Seuls ceux qui font ce que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui est au ciel veut y entreront.

sw.L: Si kila anayeniambia, 'Bwana, Bwana,' ataingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni, bali yule anayetenda mapenzi ya Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliye mbinguni.
sw.B: Si kila mtu anayeniita 'Bwana, Bwana' ataingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni, ila wale tu wanaofanya yale ambayo Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} wa mbinguni anataka.
sw.R: Si kila mtu anayeniita 'Bwana' ataingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni. Wataingia wale tu wanaofanya yale ambayo Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} wa mbinguni anataka.

vi.L: Không phải hễ ai nói với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Lạy Chúa, lạy Chúa,' thì sẽ được vào vương quốc thiên đàng, nhưng [chỉ] người làm theo ý muốn của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, Đấng ở trên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Không phải hễ ai gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là 'Lạy Chúa, lạy Chúa' thì đều được vào vương quốc thiên đàng, mà chỉ những người làm theo ý muốn của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời.
vi.R: Không phải ai gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là 'Chúa' cũng sẽ được vào vương quốc thiên đàng. Chỉ những người làm theo ý muốn của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời mới được vào.

ko.L: 나에게 '주님, 주님' 하고 말하는 사람이 다 천국에 들어갈 것이 아니라, 하늘에 계신 내 아버지의 뜻을 행하는 사람이 [들어갈 것이다].
ko.B: 나를 '주님, 주님' 하고 부르는 사람이 모두 천국에 들어가는 것은 아니다. 하늘에 계신 내 아버지의 뜻대로 행하는 사람만이 들어간다.
ko.R: 나를 '주님' 하고 부른다고 해서 모두 천국에 들어가는 것은 아니다. 하늘에 계신 내 아버지께서 원하시는 일을 하는 사람만 들어갈 것이다.

pt.L: Nem todo o que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} diz: 'Senhor, Senhor', entrará no Reino dos céus, mas o que faz a vontade do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai que [está] nos céus.
pt.B: Nem todo aquele que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chama de 'Senhor, Senhor' entrará no Reino dos céus, mas somente quem faz o que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai, que está no céu, quer.
pt.R: Nem todo aquele que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chama de 'Senhor' vai entrar no Reino dos céus. Só vão entrar os que fazem o que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai, que está no céu, quer.

am.L: “ጌታ ሆይ፣ ጌታ ሆይ” የሚለኝ ሁሉ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚገባ አይደለም፤ በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ እንጂ።
am.B: “ጌታ ሆይ፣ ጌታ ሆይ” ብሎ የሚጠራኝ ሁሉ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት አይገባም፤ የሚገቡት በሰማይ ያለው አባቴ የሚፈልገውን የሚያደርጉ ብቻ ናቸው።
am.R: “ጌታዬ” ብሎ የሚጠራኝ ሁሉ ወደ ሰማይ መንግሥት አይገባም። የሚገቡት በሰማይ ያለው አባቴ የሚፈልገውን የሚያደርጉ ብቻ ናቸው።

ru.L: Не всякий, говорящий {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}: “Господи, Господи”, войдёт в Царство Небесное, но исполняющий волю {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Отца, [который] на небесах.
ru.B: Не каждый, кто обращается ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}: “Господи, Господи”, войдёт в Царство Небесное, а лишь тот, кто делает то, чего хочет {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Отец на небесах.
ru.R: Не каждый, кто называет {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} “Господом”, войдёт в Небесное Царство. Войдут только те, кто делает то, чего хочет {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Отец на небесах.

hi.L: हर कोई जो मुझसे 'हे प्रभु, हे प्रभु' कहता है, स्वर्ग के राज्य में प्रवेश नहीं करेगा, बल्कि वह जो स्वर्ग में रहनेवाले मेरे पिता की इच्छा पूरी करता है।
hi.B: हर कोई जो मुझे 'हे प्रभु, हे प्रभु' कहकर पुकारता है, स्वर्ग के राज्य में प्रवेश नहीं करेगा, बल्कि केवल वे जो मेरे स्वर्गीय पिता की इच्छा पूरी करते हैं।
hi.R: हर कोई जो मुझे 'प्रभु' कहता है, स्वर्ग के राज्य में नहीं जाएगा। केवल वे लोग जाएँगे जो वह करते हैं जो मेरे स्वर्गीय पिता चाहते हैं।

uk.L: Не кожен, хто каже {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}: “Господи, Господи”, увійде в Царство Небесне, а той, хто виконує волю {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} Отця, що на небесах.
uk.B: Не кожен, хто звертається до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}: “Господи, Господи”, увійде в Царство Небесне, а лише ті, хто робить те, чого хоче {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Отець на небесах.
uk.R: Не кожен, хто звертається до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}: “Господи”, увійде в Небесне Царство. Увійдуть лише ті, хто робить те, чого хоче {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Отець на небі.

ja.L: わたしに『主よ、主よ』と言う者のだれもが天の国に入るのではなく、天におられるわたしの父の御心を行う者が[入る]。
ja.B: わたしを『主よ、主よ』と呼ぶ人がみな天の国に入るのではない。天におられるわたしの父が望まれることを行う人が入るのである。
ja.R: わたしを『主よ』と呼ぶ人が、みな天の国に入るのではない。天におられるわたしの父が望んでおられることをする人だけが入るのだ。

decisions.choice: Lord, Lord: calling Jesus master and lord with eager devotion
decisions.reason: The doubled word expresses earnestness. Calling Jesus Lord is not enough without doing God's will.

decisions.choice: the will of my Father: what God requires, as the sermon has set it out
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of God as "my Father" and makes himself the one whose words reveal that will (7:24).

decisions.choice: Lord
decisions.reason: Readable keeps one "Lord"; the doubling is a form of emphasis that the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: el reino de los cielos (every level)
decisions.reason: The book-wide term for Matthew's phrase: Spanish keeps the plural "cielos", which is long established, at every level, while "Padre que está en el cielo" uses the everyday singular at Balanced and Readable, as the English does.

decisions.choice: le royaume des cieux at every level (for the whole chapter); "dans les cieux" (L), "au ciel" (B, R) for where the Father is
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps Matthew's phrase at every level, as the English keeps "kingdom of heaven" at Readable. For the Father's place Balanced and Readable say "au ciel", as the English says "in heaven"; Literal keeps the plural.

decisions.choice: ufalme wa mbinguni (every level)
decisions.reason: The book-wide term for Matthew's phrase. "Mbinguni" serves for the Greek plural "heavens", since Swahili does not count heaven, and Matthew's own wording is kept rather than changed to "kingdom of God".

decisions.choice: "vương quốc thiên đàng" for "the kingdom of the heavens"
alternatives: vương quốc của các tầng trời (L)
decisions.reason: Matthew's form of "the kingdom of God". "vương quốc" follows Mark ("vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời"), and "thiên đàng" (heaven) is the word Protestant readers know from "nước thiên đàng"; the plural of the Greek is left unmarked, as in Vietnamese "trời" has no number.

decisions.choice: "Lạy Chúa" in the address; "Ta" for "me" and "Cha Ta" for "my Father"
decisions.reason: The speakers call Jesus Lord with devotion (meaning decision), so they use the style guide's "Lạy Chúa". Jesus speaks of himself as "Ta", with the setting span.

decisions.choice: "천국" at every level, through Matthew
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase for the kingdom of God ("the kingdom of the heavens") is kept rather than changed to Mark's "하나님의 나라". "천국" (the heavens' kingdom) is the established Korean term for it and is used at every level, as settled for the Korean of Matthew; it means God's reign, not only the place the dead go. Korean does not mark the Greek plural "heavens", so Literal needs no other form.

decisions.choice: "주님" for kyrie at every level
decisions.reason: The address is respectful and in Matthew more than that (meaning decision); here the speakers claim Jesus as their Lord at the judgment, so "주님" is the only fit, as in 7:22.

decisions.choice: "መንግሥተ ሰማያት" (L, B); "የሰማይ መንግሥት" (R), here after "ወደ" as "ወደ ሰማይ መንግሥት"
decisions.reason: "መንግሥተ ሰማያት" is the living church name for Matthew's "kingdom of the heavens"; Readable uses the plain Amharic phrase with the same meaning.

decisions.choice: "ጌታ ሆይ፣ ጌታ ሆይ" (L, B); "ጌታዬ" (my Lord) at R
decisions.reason: "ጌታ ሆይ" is the Amharic form of calling on someone as Lord; Readable gives the single address as the English Readable does, in the warmer everyday "ጌታዬ".

decisions.choice: "हे प्रभु"
decisions.reason: "Lord" as an address to Jesus is "हे प्रभु" in this translation.

decisions.choice: "स्वर्ग का राज्य" at every level
decisions.reason: The book's key term for the kingdom of heaven.

decisions.choice: 'Царство Небесное' (L, B); 'Небесное Царство' (R)
decisions.reason: The term this translation uses for God's rule throughout Matthew. Readable puts the adjective first, as everyday Russian does.

decisions.choice: "父の御心" (L); "父が望まれること" (B), "父が望んでおられること" (R)
decisions.reason: The will of the Father is what God requires (m2). Literal keeps the noun with the respectful "御心", written in kanji throughout; Balanced and Readable turn it into a verb, which reads more naturally.

source.text: πολλοὶ ἐροῦσίν μοι ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ· Κύριε κύριε, οὐ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι ἐπροφητεύσαμεν, καὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι δαιμόνια ἐξεβάλομεν, καὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι δυνάμεις πολλὰς ἐποιήσαμεν;

records.literal_gloss: Many will say to me in that the day, Lord, Lord, not in your name we prophesied, and in your name demons cast out, and in your name mighty works many did?

en.L: Many will say to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on that day, 'Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name cast out demons, and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name do many mighty works?'
en.B: On that day many will say to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, 'Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, drive out demons in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and do many miracles in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name?'
en.R: On judgment day many people will say to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, 'Lord, Lord, we spoke for God in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. We forced demons out of people in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and we did many miracles in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.'

es.L: Muchos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dirán en ese día: “Señor, Señor, ¿no profetizamos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, y en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre expulsamos demonios, y en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre hicimos muchas obras poderosas?”.
es.B: Aquel día muchos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dirán: “Señor, Señor, ¿acaso no profetizamos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, no expulsamos demonios en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre y no hicimos muchos milagros en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre?”.
es.R: El día del juicio mucha gente {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dirá: “Señor, Señor, nosotros hablamos de parte de Dios en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. Echamos demonios fuera de la gente en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, e hicimos muchos milagros en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre”.

fr.L: Beaucoup {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} diront en ce jour-là : “Seigneur, Seigneur, n’est-ce pas en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom que nous avons prophétisé, et en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom que nous avons chassé des démons, et en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom que nous avons fait beaucoup d’actes de puissance ?”
fr.B: Ce jour-là, beaucoup {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} diront : “Seigneur, Seigneur, n’avons-nous pas prophétisé en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ? N’avons-nous pas chassé des démons en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, et fait beaucoup de miracles en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ?”
fr.R: Le jour du jugement, beaucoup de gens {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} diront : “Seigneur, Seigneur, nous avons parlé de la part de Dieu en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. Nous avons obligé des démons à sortir des gens en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, et nous avons fait beaucoup de miracles en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.”

decisions.choice: that day: the day of judgment
alternatives: a day in the near future
decisions.reason: The prophets spoke of "that day" as the day the Lord would judge (Isaiah 2:11; Zechariah 14:4). Jesus himself is the judge (25:31-46).

decisions.choice: deeds done in his name: even real works of power do not prove a person is his
decisions.reason: Jesus does not say the deeds were fake. Gifts and powers are not the same as knowing him and doing God's will.

decisions.choice: statements instead of a question
decisions.reason: Readable states what the question claims.

decisions.choice: your name, with deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The speakers address Jesus, so "your" takes the usual span.

decisions.choice: chasser des démons (L, B), obliger des démons à sortir des gens (R); actes de puissance (L), miracles (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Un démon" is the term sheet's word. Readable says what driving out a demon is, as in the French of Mark 1:34. Literal keeps the Greek "powers" as "actes de puissance"; Balanced and Readable use the common word, as the English does. The speakers say "tu" to Jesus, so "ton nom" takes the span.

decisions.choice: "danh Chúa" for "your name", with no deity_pronoun span; "chúng con" for "we"
decisions.reason: Those who call Jesus Lord speak to him as "Chúa", a noun of address that takes no setting span (style guide, section 6), and of themselves as "chúng con".

decisions.choice: the speakers address Jesus in 합쇼체 with "저희" and "주님의 이름"
decisions.reason: People speaking to Jesus use 합쇼체 and the humble "저희" for themselves, and Korean repeats "주님" where the English has "your", since a pronoun for him would be impolite.

decisions.choice: "능력 있는 일" (L); "기적" (B); "놀라운 일" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 9:39.

decisions.choice: teu nome (tu)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: anyone who speaks to Jesus uses "tu" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4), here people who call him Lord on the day of judgment. "Teu" takes the deity_pronoun span, as the English "your" does.

decisions.choice: "የኃይል ሥራዎች" (works of power) at L; "ተአምራት" (miracles) at B and R
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "powers"; Literal keeps that, and Balanced and Readable use the ordinary word for such deeds.

decisions.choice: "आप" in the words of those who call Jesus Lord
decisions.reason: People speaking to Jesus say "आप" in this translation.

decisions.choice: the speakers address Jesus politely ("主よ", "〜ではありませんか", "〜ました") and say "あなたの名"; Jesus answers plainly as judge (7:23)
decisions.reason: They speak to him as his followers, so they use "主よ" at every level and the polite style. "あなたの名" repeats the Greek's "your name" three times, as the sentence does; "御名" would hide the repetition of the pronoun.

decisions.choice: "裁きの日" (R); "その日" (L, B)
decisions.reason: "That day" is the day of judgment (m1); Readable names it, as the English does.
